steps.caption: Locations
steps.narration: Your listings can live under more than one Google account. Here is how that shows.

steps.caption: Google connection
steps.narration: At the bottom of Locations, Google connection lists every connected account.

steps.caption: Connected
steps.narration: This account is connected. View profiles lists the listings it manages.

steps.caption: Reconnect needed
steps.narration: This one needs a reconnect: its access expired. Reconnect signs in to Google again.

steps.caption: The summary line
steps.narration: The summary counts listings synced, ready to link, and not in a connected account.

steps.caption: Connect another Google account
steps.narration: Connect another Google account adds the next login, through Google's own sign-in.

steps.caption: Sync details
steps.narration: Sync details shows each listing and the account it syncs through.

steps.caption: Via the second account
steps.narration: This listing syncs via the second account, with the last success of each part.

steps.caption: The roofing company's listing
steps.narration: Scroll down to this roofing company's listings.

steps.caption: Via its own account
steps.narration: They sync via the first account. Each listing names the account that manages it.

steps.caption: Sync now
steps.narration: Sync now refreshes one listing sooner; otherwise each syncs on its schedule.

steps.caption: Menu: Locations
steps.narration: You'll find Locations in the Google Business menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to manage listings under several Google accounts | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: How ConstructHUB handles listings that live under more than one Google account. The Google connection section on Locations lists every connected account with its state, counts what is synced, ready to link or not in a connected account, and Sync details names the account each listing syncs through.
